description:
Our
 **On\-Demand Talent Solutions** 
 team excited to announce that we are hiring a
 **Software Quality Assurance Staff Engineer** 
 on behalf of our client. Our client focuses on rethinking protein tools and helping world wide researchers reveal new insights into proteins and their role in diseases. The ideal candidate should have the ability to work independently in a fast paced\-environment as well as collaborate within cross functional teams.
 



  





**Summary:** 
 The Software Quality Assurance Staff Engineer will collaborate with other software engineers to further develop analytical applications and work on the design of graphical data presentations, algorithms, device communications, and complex data workflows.
 



  





**\*\*\*Not accepting C2C candidates at this time\*\*\*** 




  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Develop high\-quality, detailed, and traceable test cases aligned with software requirements and user stories for instrument software applications, ensuring traceability between requirements, test cases, and validation results in compliance with quality system procedures and regulatory standards (e.g., ISO 13485/IVDR).
* Validate end\-to\-end system workflows from instrument data generation through data analysis and reporting, identifying, isolating, and documenting defects with sufficient detail to enable efficient resolution.
* Review software requirements and provide early, actionable feedback to improve testability and coverage while collaborating with software, hardware, and data teams to drive product quality and system reliability.
* Design and execute automated test frameworks for cross\-system software using Python for data preparation and validation of system logic, workflows, and defect fixes.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools (e.g., Copilot and Claude Code) to improve test design, accelerate automation development, and enhance overall software quality.
* Apply strong technical judgment, analytical problem\-solving, and attention to detail across test design, execution, documentation, and validation.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 5\-10 years of Software Quality Assurance experience, preferably in life sciences, medical devices, or other regulated environments.
* Background in testing instrument software, data analysis applications, or integrated systems.
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), QA methodologies, and experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with frequent release cycles.
* Proficient in testing automation tools (e.g., TestComplete, Ranorex, Squish), Python or other scripting languages, version control systems (Git), and CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins).
* Experience executing software verification and validation plans, including documentation of test procedures, reports, and results, and preparing complex data sets to validate system logic, error handling, and workflows.
* Ability to review requirements, specifications, and technical documentation to improve quality and testability while demonstrating exceptional attention to detail and accuracy across all deliverables.
